b.x: This is not a diagnosis and it does not replace the nurse. The usual rhythm of the house is to turn every two hours, day and night, so blood reaches the skin that was underneath. Left, back, right. Never only the back the whole night. At the hour of eating or drinking, the head of the bed goes up. Water comes in sips, in the glass you count. The medicine is what is already written on the box, at the hour the doctor gave, not an hour invented here. At each turn, look at the skin: if the redness does not fade, if the skin opened, if a fever came, if drinking stopped, if the breathing changed or if they do not wake as usual, the step is 192. This screen does not dial. And whoever cares is also the house: if you do not eat and do not sleep one block, both fall. It stays on this device. It does not leave.

BUILD IT ONCE

Build it once. Both sides of the bed clear, if the house allows, so you turn without dragging. Sheet pulled smooth: a fold marks the skin. One pillow at the back, so the body does not fall, and another between the knees. The heel does not rest on the mattress. Water, the medicine from the box, and an object that makes a noise stay within reach of the hand, if the hand still reaches. The night light is low, enough to see the skin, not a torch in the eye. Do not do this when the spine is in doubt: then the person who moves them is the one who was taught, not an improvisation.

The step of whoever cares
The gray one does not improvise the body of someone who cannot turn. He follows the step. If it worsens, he does not solve it alone: he calls the person who was taught.
Wash your hands before you touch the person.
Look at the face and the breathing before you do anything. If they do not wake as usual, stop. The step is 192.
Turn at the saved hour. Left, back, right. Sheet smooth. Heel off the mattress. Do not rub red skin.
Diaper: clean from front to back, dry, do not leave it wet. Look at the groin fold and the base of the spine.

Water in sips, only if they still swallow, with the head of the bed up. If they do not swallow, do not force it. Food is what the house already eats. Medicine is what is on the box, at the hour the doctor gave.
Speak to the person. One true thing. Do not speak of them as if the room were empty. Hearing usually remains.
IF IT WORSENS

If it worsens, the house does not cure. The house sees and calls. Redness that does not fade: turn more and tell the nurse the same day. Do not rub and do not put a product from the cupboard. Skin that opened: clean water only if the nurse already taught it, a dry cloth over it, and the team today. Do not cut. Do not close it. Infection is redness that grows, heat, pus, a bad smell, fever, or confusion. That is not solved at home. The team today. If the breathing falls, if they do not wake, if one leg swells and heats and the breath fails all at once: do not massage the leg. The step is 192. A cough with phlegm and breath that costs: sit the person up and call the team. A long sadness, food that stops, or the sentence that they do not want to live: do not leave that sentence alone. The doctor, and 188. Joy here is not a party. It is a clean sheet, a known voice, a window, and not being treated as someone already gone.
THE SUN

Sun, only if the doctor did not forbid it and the medicine box does not say to avoid the sun. Do not put an open wound in direct sun. Someone stays. Ten to fifteen minutes, early or late in the afternoon, not at midday if the skin burns. Eyes protected. Head supported. If they redden, sweat, shiver, or say it hurts, go back inside. The sun is for the day and for the mood. It is not a treatment. If the doctor said no, do not go.
WHEN THE AIM IS COMFORT

When the doctor has already said the aim is comfort, the house changes the question. It is no longer to beat the illness. It is not to leave the person in pain, with a dry mouth, afraid, and alone. The dose is not invented here. What is on the box, at the hour the team gave, is what is given. What the house watches is the face, the breathing, and the body that refuses the turn. That is told to the people who truly care, not posted. A dry mouth is wet with a cloth, a little, if the person still swallows. If they do not swallow, water is not forced. What is not swallowed can go to the lung. Breathlessness, when it was already expected, eases a little with the head of the bed up, the window open, and air on the face. If the breathing falls in a way nobody expected, the step is still 192. If the team already left a plan for the last hours, follow that plan, not this page. Speak as to someone who hears. Hearing is often the last to go. Do not speak of the person as if the room were empty. And do not film.
